rag.text:
Test: TC-1744 — Feature area - Box - Box scheduling - Auto scope-based child Box behavior when an Auto top-down parent Box is moved or resized
Priority: Medium | Status: To Do | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-91 Feature area - Box - Box scheduling
Labels: cloud2do, teamboxes

Description:
Na podstawie Test 4 z ONE-33265

Steps:
1. Open the boxName on the Overview in the Timeline mode.
Make sure that the hierarchy is expanded and adjust the grid with "Scale to fit".
   Data: boxName: TC-1744 MAN
   Expected: Box "TC-1744 MAN" opens on the Timeline mode. Under it, there is the "ATD" Box, with "ASB" Box under.
2. Resize the boxName to the new startDate
   Data: boxName: ATD
startDate: 30/Apr/21
   Expected: The "ATD" Box is resized to 30/Apr/21-02/Jun/21.
The "ASB" Box remains at 28/Apr/21-02/Jun/21
3. Resize the boxName to the new startDate
   Data: boxName: ATD
startDate: 26/Apr/21
   Expected: The "ATD" Box is resized to 26/Apr/21-02/Jun/21.
The "ASB" Box remains at 28/Apr/21-02/Jun/21
4. Resize the boxName to the new endtDate
   Data: boxName: ATD
endtDate: 04/Jun/21
   Expected: The "ATD" Box is resized to 26/Apr/21-04/Jun/21.
The "ASB" Box remains at 28/Apr/21-02/Jun/21
5. Move the boxName to the new startDate
   Data: boxName: ATD
startDate: 30/Apr/21
   Expected: The "ATD" Box is moved to 30/Apr/21-06/Jun/21.
The "ASB" Box remains at 28/Apr/21-02/Jun/21
